data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.identify-account-auth.Title
data.value: Identify the affected account

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.identify-account-auth.Instruction
data.value: Confirm the exact GitHub account and that the currently signed-in session belongs to it.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.identify-account-auth.Warning
data.value: Do not enter passwords, reset links, MFA secrets, recovery codes, cookies, or browser storage into unpwn.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.identify-account-auth.Completion
data.value: Account identification recorded

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.identify-account-auth.Criterion.1
data.value: The affected account has been identified.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.change-password.Title
data.value: Change the password

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.change-password.Instruction
data.value: Open the official authenticated security settings and choose a new generated credential for this account.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.change-password.Warning
data.value: Confirm the displayed destination and origin before opening the browser. Returning to unpwn does not prove that the password changed.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.change-password.Completion
data.value: Password change recorded

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.change-password.Criterion.1
data.value: The account password has been changed through the official authenticated flow.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-mfa-auth.Title
data.value: Review MFA and passkeys

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-mfa-auth.Instruction
data.value: Review registered MFA methods, passkeys, security keys, and recovery codes. Remove or replace anything you do not recognize.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-mfa-auth.Warning
data.value: Do not copy MFA secrets or recovery codes into unpwn notes.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-mfa-auth.Completion
data.value: MFA review recorded

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-mfa-auth.Criterion.1
data.value: MFA methods and recovery codes have been reviewed or an unresolved risk has been recorded.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.invalidate-sessions-auth.Title
data.value: Review and revoke sessions

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.invalidate-sessions-auth.Instruction
data.value: Review active sessions and trusted devices and revoke access that is unknown or no longer required.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.invalidate-sessions-auth.Warning
data.value: Opening the provider page does not confirm that sessions were revoked.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.invalidate-sessions-auth.Completion
data.value: Session review recorded

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.invalidate-sessions-auth.Criterion.1
data.value: Active sessions and trusted devices have been reviewed and revoked where appropriate.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-recovery-options-auth.Title
data.value: Review recovery options

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-recovery-options-auth.Instruction
data.value: Review recovery email addresses, telephone numbers, and other recovery methods and correct unauthorized or outdated entries.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-recovery-options-auth.Warning
data.value: Do not enter verification codes, reset links, or recovery secrets into unpwn.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-recovery-options-auth.Completion
data.value: Recovery options review recorded

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-recovery-options-auth.Criterion.1
data.value: Recovery methods have been reviewed and corrected where possible.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-connected-apps-auth.Title
data.value: Review connected applications

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-connected-apps-auth.Instruction
data.value: Review connected applications and integrations and revoke access that is unknown or no longer required.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-connected-apps-auth.Warning
data.value: Do not authorize a new application merely because it appears during recovery.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-connected-apps-auth.Completion
data.value: Connected application review recorded

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-connected-apps-auth.Criterion.1
data.value: Connected applications have been reviewed and unauthorized access has been revoked.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-api-tokens-auth.Title
data.value: Review tokens and keys

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-api-tokens-auth.Instruction
data.value: Review personal access tokens, SSH keys, and signing keys and revoke or rotate anything unauthorized or exposed.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-api-tokens-auth.Warning
data.value: Do not paste token or private-key values into unpwn.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-api-tokens-auth.Completion
data.value: Token and key review recorded

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.review-api-tokens-auth.Criterion.1
data.value: Personal access tokens and SSH or signing keys have been reviewed and rotated or revoked where appropriate.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.document-completion-auth.Title
data.value: Review the account outcome

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.document-completion-auth.Instruction
data.value: Review every required action and record any blocked work, lost access, or unresolved risk before leaving this account.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.document-completion-auth.Warning
data.value: Completion means the review was documented; it is not proof that the device or account is secure.

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.document-completion-auth.Completion
data.value: Account outcome documented

data.name: Workflow.GitHub.Action.document-completion-auth.Criterion.1
data.value: Completion records remaining unresolved risks without claiming unsupported security guarantees.

data.value: Identify the account and available evidence
